Commercial Growth Leader
Transforms enterprise marketing organizations into revenue-generating growth engines
Managed an $8M Ford commercial portfolio and secured a ₹36 Cr BMW 3-year service retainer transformation engagement.
Recruited and scaled a 40-member cross-functional Performance Marketing Center of Excellence (CoE / GCC).
Led a complex legacy-to-Salesforce CRM migration across 13 APAC and Middle East markets within 12 months.
Established a Digital Analytics & Experimentation Lab embedding A/B testing into structural decision-making.
Redesigned digital customer journeys resulting in $14M of attributed incremental revenue.
Grew Ford's digital revenue contribution from 3% to over 32% in five years via performance marketing initiatives.
Generated 400,000+ organic qualified leads using AI and NLP-powered hyperlocal marketing at TVS Motor Company.

Outperformed baseline commercial and lead acquisition targets for 3 successive fiscal cycles by up to 14%.
Migrated legacy CRMs to Salesforce Marketing Cloud and Salesforce CDP across 13 international markets within 12 months.
Accountable for P&L management, delivery, and scaling of an $8M agency fee book for Ford and a ₹36 Cr BMW digital transformation retainer.
Built and managed a 40-person cross-functional Global Capability Center (GCC) specialized in digital and performance marketing execution.
Created an internal Digital Analytics & Experimentation Lab to build a 'Global First' Online-to-Offline (O2O) attribution framework.
